metadata.title: docs: add release management process documentation
metadata.author: crivetimihai

description:
## Summary
- Adds comprehensive release management checklist to `docs/docs/development/release-management.md`
- 16-section process covering the full release lifecycle from pre-release prep through post-release
- Adds the page to the development docs navigation in `.pages`

## Sections
1. Version Update (bump, stale refs, CHANGELOG, roadmap, security advisories, base images)
2. Python Dependency Updates (update_dependencies.py, pip-audit)
3. Rust/Go/JS/CDN Dependency Updates (cargo update, go get -u, npm update, SRI hashes)
4. Quality Gates (formatting, linting, config validation, secrets scanning, security analysis, license headers)
5. Test Gates (Python coverage, JS coverage, Playwright UI, MCP protocol, load testing)
6. Build Verification (docker-prod, hadolint/dockle/trivy, compose stack, embedded mode, package)
7. SSO Verification (Keycloak login flow)
8. Observability Verification (monitoring stack under load)
9. Security & Analysis (SonarQube, semgrep, SBOM, container scanning)
10. Deployment Verification (Helm lint, kube-linter, Checkov, Minikube deploy)
11. Documentation Verification (broken links, mkdocs build/deploy)
12. Plugin Testing (PII filter enforcement, tool invocation, MCP protocol, unit tests)
13. Upgrade Testing (automated upgrade-validate, manual PostgreSQL/SQLite, migration suite)
14. Manual Testing (JWT tokens, SSE/Streamable HTTP servers, virtual servers, MCP Inspector, VS Code)
15. Draft Release (commit, tag, GitHub Release, CI pipeline verification)
16. Post-Release (milestone cleanup, next milestone, docs, announcements)

Includes a copy-paste Quick Reference with all gate commands in sequence.

commits.message:

build verification, SSO, observability, security analysis, deployment,
